title: Add persistent preferred theme field for admins
body: ## Summary Adds a `preferred_theme` column to the `Admin` model so each admin's chosen UI color theme is persisted server-side. When an admin selects a theme from the dropdown, it is saved to the database via an AJAX call and automatically applied on subsequent logins — no need to re-select the theme each time. **Changes:** - **`cms/db/admin.py`** — Added nullable `preferred_theme` column with a `CHECK` constraint limiting values to the six valid theme IDs, plus a `VALID_THEMES` constant. - **`cmscontrib/updaters/update_from_1.5.sql`** — SQL migration to add the column and constraint. - **`cms/server/admin/handlers/admin.py`** — New `AdminThemeHandler` with a `POST` endpoint at `/admin/theme` that accepts `{"theme": ""}` JSON and persists the preference. Any authenticated admin can save their own theme. - **`cms/server/admin/handlers/__init__.py`** — Registered the new route and import. - **`cms/server/admin/templates/base.html`** — `initThemeToggle()` now reads the server-side `admin.preferred_theme` as the primary source (falling back to `localStorage`), and fires an AJAX POST on theme change. - **`cms/server/admin/templates/login.html`** — Applies the saved theme for already-logged-in admins visiting the login page. ## Review & Testing Checklist for Human - [ ] Run the SQL migration on a test database and verify the `preferred_theme` column and constraint are created on `admins` - [ ] Log in as an admin, change the theme, log out and back in — verify the theme persists - [ ] Log in from a different browser/incognito (no localStorage) — verify the server-saved theme is applied - [ ] Try setting an invalid theme via direct POST to `/admin/theme` — should return 400 ### Notes - The theme is nullable — `NULL` means "use default (original)". Existing admins get `NULL` after migration. - `localStorage` is still used as a fast client-side cache to avoid flash-of-wrong-theme, but the server value takes priority when available. Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/09615107f41848b1846f115ca6056d37 Requested by: @ronryv --- ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **New Features** * Admin users can save a preferred UI theme that persists across sessions and is applied on login. * Theme selection updates local storage and persists to the server so preferences follow the user. * **Bug Fixes** * If saving a theme fails, the UI and local storage are reverted to the previous theme to avoid inconsistent state.
